summary.intent: Assess and close a set of stale/umbrella GitHub issues (#635, #991, #992) in cipher-box, audit all open comp:engine issues for validity, then run a much larger effort: audit the entire blueprint/CONTEXT.md commit history for missing ADRs, draft and land 23 retroactive ADRs (0029-0051), reword the blueprint to match, and finally plan/execute the move of the ADR decision corpus from cipher-box-next into cipher-box.
summary.outcome: All target issues closed/rescoped; 23 ADRs drafted, independently reviewed, and merged into cipher-box-next with status flipped to Accepted; blueprint/CONTEXT.md/AGENTS.md reworded to match (PR #2028) with review-driven fixes; code/workflow comments updated (PR #2029) and older ADRs/threads amended (PR #111); nine real defects filed as tracked issues; the ADR repo move began with PR #2030 (ADR copy, green CI, awaiting merge) and PR #2031/docs-cleanup PR in flight.

repo: Decision corpus lives in FSM1/cipher-box-next: ADR files in decisions/ (28 existing before this session, now 51) plus wayfinder thread decisions cited as '#NN Dn'; tracker-refs gate exempts 1-2 digit #NN assuming it can only reference cipher-box-next

Agent-authored GitHub comments/issue bodies posted under the owner's account (FSM1) are NOT proof of an owner decision unless there's an explicit in-session record — the owner ruled such in-session records DO count, and so do map #813 resolution comments approved by the owner
cipher-box allows squash merges only, so ADR history from cipher-box-next commits cannot be preserved via merge commit when moving files — must reference the source repo/sha instead
markdownlint refuses to lint files outside the repo tree; must pipe via --stdin --config .markdownlint.json or lint in-tree
Nested sub-agent completion results can route to the top-level orchestrator instead of the direct parent agent — must be manually forwarded via SendMessage

Entire commit-msg hook (v0.8.42) only adds Entire-Checkpoint trailer for a live tracked session in manual-commit mode; it does not track sub-agent sessions, so amending/squashing a sub-agent's commit drops the trailer and it must be restored by hand from git reflog

gh CLI must always be invoked as `env -u GITHUB_TOKEN gh ...` in this environment; GraphQL API quota can be exhausted by many parallel sub-agents' gh calls, requiring fallback to REST (gh api -X POST ...)
docs-only PRs use '@coderabbitai ignore' in the body and merge on green CI without full review; code PRs go draft → '@coderabbitai review' → resolve findings → merge
specs/ folder in cipher-box-next is v1-only as-built documentation with zero inbound links from ADRs/blueprint/CONTEXT.md/AGENTS.md — safe to leave behind when archiving
v1 code is frozen on a 'v1' branch and 'v1-freeze' tag of cipher-box, so v1 docs preserved there don't need duplicating on main

code.finding: publish_record always uploaded head block to hosted endpoint regardless of placement mode before the ADR 0029 D1 fix — root cause of the #2006 External-mode lockout defect

API throws ConflictException for every hosted upload when user.byo=true, with no exemption for record head blocks vs content bytes — this combined with record_publish.rs always uploading heads caused the External placement lockout

workflow: Splitting large audit/review work across many parallel sub-agents (grouped by file/issue ownership) with a writer→independent-reviewer→apply-fixes pipeline scales well for retroactive ADR drafting, but requires careful orchestration of notification routing and re-verification against a moving main HEAD
When background agents complete mid-session and main has advanced (new PRs merged), always re-verify findings against the new HEAD rather than trusting the original audit

For large mechanical edits (blueprint reword across 9 files from 23 ADRs), split into extraction agents (one per ADR group) then editing agents (one per target file) then a single independent diff-reviewer to catch cross-file inconsistencies the extraction step missed
Filing follow-up issues for defects discovered during ADR review, and blocking the newly-decided ADR text on those issues, keeps the ADR-as-record process honest without holding up acceptance
